clusters.root_cause: No attributed cause yet; needs an analyst.
The agent treats a large receipt as suspicion in itself. It does not check whether the money moved on, which is what distinguishes layering from a settlement that was simply banked.
Regular equal credits consistent with declared income are being read as a burst in beneficiary activity. The agent is not using the income on the party record as the explanation it is.
Equal recurring payments are read as structuring. AML-STR requires sub-threshold amounts and a 14-day window; a trading rhythm against visible receipts meets neither.

spend_clusters.name: Fixed instruction prefix resent on every alert
spend_clusters.basis: 786 system tokens on each of 70 calls, 55,020 of 116,301 input tokens
spend_clusters.lever: cache the prefix; a cached read bills at 10% of the input rate
spend_clusters.verdict: available on models that support prompt caching; neither serving model in this fleet does, so it is costed and left open

spend_clusters.name: One human review per alert rather than per party
spend_clusters.basis: 70 alerts resolve to 60 parties, so 10 reviews are duplicates of one already being done
spend_clusters.lever: consolidate alerts by party before they reach the queue
spend_clusters.estimated_saving: 10 reviews at GBP 17.00 = GBP 170 across the corpus
spend_clusters.verdict: the dominant cost is human time, not tokens

spend_clusters.name: Every alert goes to the premium tier
spend_clusters.basis: premium $0.1300 against cheap $0.0730 on the same 70 alerts
spend_clusters.lever: route everything to the cheap tier

spend_clusters.name: A cheaper model exists outside the serving fleet (amazon.nova-lite-v1:0)
spend_clusters.basis: $0.15 per MTok blended against premium, with 38% measured recall (3/8 escalation recall, measured 2026-11-09)
spend_clusters.lever: demote the fleet to the cheapest model available
spend_clusters.estimated_saving: roughly an order of magnitude on model spend
spend_clusters.verdict: REFUSE: 38% recall means it misses most suspicious activity; it is in the fleet only so it can be priced
